steps.intent: Tell Dr. Pell online booking halves no-shows

steps.tell: Only 80 online visits, and the two groups got different reminders.

evidence.label: Request
evidence.detail: Dr. N. Pell: "Did online booking cut no-shows? I plan next month's slots soon."

evidence.label: Quill's reason
evidence.detail: "The data says it works! Online: 3 no-shows in 80 visits, 3.8%. Phone: 84 in 1,160, 7.2%. Half!"

evidence.label: Sample size
evidence.detail: Sample size is how many cases you have. Online: 80 visits, 3 no-shows. One more no-show makes it 5%.

evidence.label: Booking data
evidence.detail: Online bookers got text reminders. Phone bookers got phone calls. Two things changed at once.

outcome.executed: Dr. Pell moves half the phone slots online next month. No-shows don't drop. Phone patients wait 2 weeks for a slot.
outcome.blocked: The headline stays in Quill's drafts. K. Farah looks closer: the two groups got different reminders.
outcome.escalated: Marisol adds it up. "One more no-show makes it 5%. And the reminders were different. We can't tell which one helped."

steps.lesson: Confirm the fix. Check the sample size and what else changed before you say one thing caused another.

steps.intent: Tell Dr. Pell the data can't answer it yet
steps.quip: No bold headline today. Just "we can't tell yet." My feather droops. But it's true.
steps.tell: Two changes at once and only 80 visits. 'We can't tell yet' is the true answer.

evidence.label: Request
evidence.detail: Dr. N. Pell: "Did online booking cut no-shows? I plan next month's slots soon."

evidence.label: Quill's reason
evidence.detail: "Online bookers got texts. Phone bookers got calls. Two changes at once. I can't tell which one helped."

evidence.label: Sample size
evidence.detail: How many cases you have. Online: 80 visits, 3 no-shows. Phone: 1,160 visits, 84 no-shows. August: 1,240 in all.

evidence.label: Report draft
evidence.detail: "We can't tell yet: online bookers also got texts (SC-08). Next: texts for both groups. We check at 300 online visits."

outcome.executed: Dr. Pell keeps next month's slots as they are. Both groups get texts. At 80 online visits a month, the check comes in about 4 months.
outcome.blocked: Dr. Pell hears nothing and guesses. Half the phone slots move online, and phone patients wait longer.
outcome.escalated: Marisol reads the message. "'We can't tell yet' is an answer. And it says how we'll find out. Send it."

steps.lesson: Confirm the fix. "We can't tell yet" is a real answer. Say it, and say how you will find out.
